{{Short description|New Zealand mathematician and university professor (1868–1954)}}
{{Use New Zealand English|date=December 2024}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2017}}
[[File:Segar-hugh-william-ap-1.jpg|thumb|Segar (year unknown)]]
'''Hugh William Segar''' (31 January 1868 &ndash; 18 September 1954) was a New Zealand mathematician and university professor. He was born in [[Liverpool]], [[Lancashire]], [[England]] in 1868.<ref name="DNZB Segar">{{DNZB|title=Hugh William Segar|first= D. A.|last= Nield|id=3s9|accessdate=23 April 2017}}</ref>  He was educated at [[Liverpool College]] and [[Trinity College, Cambridge]], where he was 2nd Wrangler and a Yeats Prizeman.<ref name="auto">''Who Was Who'', Published by [[A & C Black|A&C Black Limited]].  Online edition, 2020</ref>  He was Professor of Mathematics at [[University College, Auckland]].<ref name="auto">''Who Was Who'', Published by [[A & C Black|A&C Black Limited]].  Online edition, 2020</ref>
